constraints: Preserve the deterministic core and external agent CLI adapter boundary.
Do not introduce provider SDK dependencies into the core.
Use argv subprocess execution without a shell.
Keep the implementation minimal and portable as a single Go CLI.
Pin optional mermaid-spec tooling to commit 7cde6be8c8e4e6b0e26ac4f5d58873be5aa3163b and keep Bun outside the released Go binary.
Generate bounded agent context from explicit contract-to-file links and require full verification before terminal completion.
Require graph evidence when a repository declares .groundspec/graph.json or passes --graph, while preserving lifecycle compatibility for workspaces that have not adopted a graph.
